s1.syndrome_frame: Gradually developing skin lesion with verrucous appearance and soft-tissue mass
salient_findings: Slightly reddish verrucous plaque on the right temple
Translucent papules and plaques with surface hemorrhagic crust
Papillomatous epidermal hyperplasia and neoplastic infiltration of small round blue cells
key_facts: Asymptomatic skin lesion on the right temple
Lesion gradually developed over 8 months
No associated fevers, weight loss, or night sweats
Lesion is nontender with no purulent discharge
No hepatosplenomegaly or superficial lymphadenopathy
Laboratory tests showed no abnormalities
Imaging studies revealed skin thickening and a soft-tissue mass in the right frontotemporal region
Histopathology showed papillomatous epidermal hyperplasia and neoplastic infiltration
Tumor cells are positive for MyoD1, myogenin, vimentin, and desmin

shortlist.label: Rhabdomyosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Positive for MyoD1, myogenin, vimentin, and desmin, consistent with rhabdomyosarcoma

shortlist.label: Verrucous carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Verrucous appearance and gradual development of the skin lesion

shortlist.label: Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans
shortlist.why_kept: Soft-tissue mass and skin thickening in the right frontotemporal region

shortlist.label: Leiomyosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Neoplastic infiltration with small round blue cells and positive for vimentin and desmin

shortlist.label: Ewing sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Small round blue cells with hyperchromatic nuclei and conspicuous nucleoli, although less likely due to lack of CD99 positivity

raw.rationale: The tumor cells are positive for MyoD1, myogenin, vimentin, and desmin, which are markers for muscle differentiation, consistent with rhabdomyosarcoma. The histopathology also shows small round blue cells with features of neoplastic infiltration, which is typical of rhabdomyosarcoma.

rejected.label: Verrucous carcinoma
rejected.why: While the lesion has a verrucous appearance, the presence of small round blue cells and positive staining for MyoD1 and myogenin suggest a diagnosis of rhabdomyosarcoma rather than verrucous carcinoma.

rejected.label: Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans
rejected.why: The histopathology and immunohistochemistry results do not support a diagnosis of dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans, which typically shows a storiform pattern of spindle cells and is positive for CD34.

rejected.label: Leiomyosarcoma
rejected.why: The tumor cells do not show the typical features of leiomyosarcoma, such as spindle cell morphology and positive staining for smooth muscle actin.

rejected.label: Ewing sarcoma
rejected.why: The tumor cells do not show the typical features of Ewing sarcoma, such as positive staining for CD99 and FLI-1.
